items.help: Extra gid allowed on the admin socket; -1 for none.

items.label: First-boot admin password file

fields.name: id

fields.name: issuer
fields.label: Issuer
fields.help: OpenID Provider issuer URL (https).

fields.name: redirectURL
fields.label: Redirect URL

items.help: How Kubernetes service-account tokens are authorized: sar (SubjectAccessReview on kudurru.io resources). impersonate is v0.2.

enum.label: SubjectAccessReview

items.help: Local password login (POST /api/v1/auth/login): enabled, admins-only (builtin admins only) or disabled; `kudurru admin` over the admin socket always works.
items.label: Local password login

enum.label: Enabled
enum.help: Every local user may log in with a password.

enum.label: Admins only
enum.help: Only builtin admins may log in with a password.

enum.label: Disabled
enum.help: No password login; kudurru admin over the admin socket always works.

items.help: Sliding idle timeout of a UI session (at least 1m).
items.label: Session idle timeout

items.help: Absolute lifetime of a UI session; roles are re-resolved at the next login.
items.label: Session lifetime

items.help: Session cookie Secure attribute: auto (when TLS terminates here or a trusted proxy reports https), always or never.
items.label: Secure session cookie

enum.label: Auto
enum.help: When TLS terminates here or a trusted proxy reports https.

enum.label: Always
enum.help: Behind a proxy that terminates TLS without telling kudurru.

enum.label: Never
enum.help: Plain HTTP only; the cookie can be read on the wire.

items.help: Longest lifetime of a new API token; tokens without expiry get it. 0 allows tokens that never expire.
items.label: Maximum token lifetime

items.help: Report ready and serve while referenced blocklists are not loaded yet (queries are filtered by the lists that are loaded).
items.label: Serve while lists load

items.help: Let BlockList URLs reach loopback, link-local (169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10: cloud metadata), unspecified and multicast addresses. Off by default so a BlockList writer cannot make the node fetch its own or the cloud's internal services (SSRF); private LAN ranges are always allowed.
items.label: Allow local list URLs

items.help: TTL of block responses when the Policy sets no blockTTL; short so a one-click allow takes effect quickly.
items.label: Block response TTL

items.help: How often the leader downloads blocking.catalogue.url (at least 1m; conditional GET).
items.label: Catalogue refresh interval

items.help: URL of a blocked-services and safe-search catalogue document (schema version 1, docs/deploy/blocked-services.md) that replaces the embedded one; empty serves the catalogue built into the binary. The leader downloads it, replicas pull the leader's copy; a document that fails validation keeps the catalogue in service.
items.label: Catalogue URL

items.help: IPv4 answer for blocked A queries when the response is customIP; empty answers NODATA.
items.label: Custom block IPv4

items.help: IPv6 answer for blocked AAAA queries when the response is customIP; empty answers NODATA.
items.label: Custom block IPv6

items.help: Block response when neither the Policy (blockMode) nor the BlockList (response) sets one: zeroIP (0.0.0.0 / ::, other types NODATA), nxdomain, customIP (blocking.customIP), refused (discouraged: stub resolvers fail over), blockPage (A and AAAA answer the block page address, other types NODATA).
items.label: Default block response

enum.label: Zero IP
enum.help: 0.0.0.0 for A, :: for AAAA; other types NODATA.

enum.label: NXDOMAIN
enum.help: The name does not exist.

enum.label: Custom IP
enum.help: The addresses in blocking.customIP.v4 and v6; NODATA for a family without one.

enum.label: REFUSED
enum.help: Discouraged: stub resolvers fail over to another server.

enum.label: Block page
enum.help: A and AAAA point at the block page, which tells a browser why the name was blocked; other types NODATA.

items.help: Apply blocklists to recursive queries; false answers everything unfiltered (temporary disable is a runtime toggle, not this key).
items.label: Blocking enabled

items.help: Blocklist loading at start: fast (serve at once from the disk cache, load in the background), blocking (not ready until every list is loaded), failOnError (blocking, and exit when a list fails to load).
items.label: List loading at start

enum.label: Fast
enum.help: Serve at once from the disk cache, load in the background.

enum.label: Wait for lists
enum.help: Not ready until every list is loaded.

enum.label: Fail on error
enum.help: Wait for every list, and exit when one fails to load.

items.help: Blocklist body cache (sha256(url) files); empty means <node.dataDir>/lists.
items.label: List cache directory

items.help: Refresh interval of BlockLists that set no spec.refreshInterval (at least 1m); the leader fetches, replicas pull by digest.
items.label: List refresh interval

items.help: Maximum number of cached responses (LRU beyond it); 0 disables the cache.
items.label: Maximum cache entries

items.help: Upper clamp for answer TTLs.
items.label: Maximum TTL

items.help: Lower clamp for positive answer TTLs.
items.label: Minimum TTL

items.help: Upper clamp for NXDOMAIN/NODATA TTLs (RFC 2308 SOA minimum otherwise).
items.label: Maximum negative TTL

items.help: Hits within prefetch.window that make an entry hot enough to refresh before it expires; 0 disables prefetch.
items.label: Prefetch threshold (hits)

items.help: Window over which prefetch hits are counted.
items.label: Prefetch window

items.help: TTL of stale answers (RFC 8767).
items.label: Stale answer TTL

items.help: How long a query for an expired entry waits for the upstream refresh before the stale answer is sent (RFC 8767 client response timer).
items.label: Stale answer wait

items.label: Serve stale for

items.label: external-dns webhook address

items.help: Namespace of the DNSRecordSets the webhook writes (managed by integration:external-dns, one record set per DNS name).
items.label: external-dns record namespace

items.help: Label selector (key: value) choosing the primary DNSZones external-dns may write to; empty allows every primary zone.
items.label: external-dns zone selector

items.help: HTTP API and UI listener.

items.help: TLS for the API listener when no certFile is set: selfsigned (generate a certificate once into <node.dataDir>/keys/) or off (plain HTTP, e.g. behind a TLS-terminating proxy).

enum.help: Generate a certificate once into <node.dataDir>/keys/.

enum.label: Off (plain HTTP)
enum.help: For a TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front.

items.label: Internal certificate file

items.label: Client anonymization

enum.label: Pseudonym
enum.help: HMAC with a random in-memory key rotated daily; stable for a day, not reversible.

items.help: Collect the per-node query log (querylog.db, rollups and the stats API).
items.label: Query log enabled

items.help: Clients never logged: IP addresses, CIDR prefixes or client names.
items.label: Clients never logged

items.help: Names never logged: exact names, *.suffix wildcards (the suffix and everything below it) or /regex/.
items.label: Domains never logged

items.help: Do not log special-use names (localhost, .local, .home.arpa, private and link-local reverse zones).
items.label: Skip special-use names

enum.label: Full
enum.help: Everything, including the answer summary.

enum.label: Anonymize clients
enum.help: Client addresses hidden as set by querylog.anonymize.

enum.label: Hide domains
enum.help: Query names are not stored.

enum.label: Hide domains and clients
enum.help: Neither query names nor clients are stored.

enum.label: Totals only
enum.help: Per-minute totals only, no rows.

items.help: Upper bound for querylog.db; the oldest rows are deleted first when it is exceeded. 0 disables the cap.
items.label: Maximum query log size

items.help: How long per-query rows are kept (rollups: 35 d per minute, 400 d per hour, daily forever); 0 keeps rows until maxDBBytes is reached.
items.label: Keep query rows for

items.help: Built-in query-log sink: sqlite (querylog.db with rollups; required for the dashboard) or slog (one JSON log line per query, nothing stored).
items.label: Query log sink

enum.label: SQLite
enum.help: querylog.db with rollups; required for the dashboard.

enum.label: Log lines
enum.help: One JSON log line per query, nothing stored.

items.help: Per-prefix QPM rate limiting of UDP queries at ingress; TCP, DoT, DoH, DoQ and DoH3 are never limited, nor loopback clients and the health name.
items.label: Rate limiting enabled

items.help: CIDRs or addresses never rate limited (loopback always is).
items.label: Exempt clients

items.help: IPv4 prefix length to queries per minute per prefix (token bucket holding one minute's allowance); merged with the defaults key by key, 0 disables a level.
items.label: IPv4 limits (queries per minute)

items.help: IPv6 prefix length to queries per minute per prefix; merged with the defaults key by key, 0 disables a level.
items.label: IPv6 limits (queries per minute)

items.label: Tracked prefixes

items.help: Percentage (0-100) of over-limit UDP queries answered with an empty TC=1 response so real clients retry over TCP; the rest are dropped.
items.label: Slip (percent answered TC=1)

items.label: Role bindings

enum.help: Read zones, records, lists, policies, stats and settings.

enum.label: Auditor
enum.help: Viewer plus the query log and the audit log.

enum.label: Operator
enum.help: Manage records, lists, policies, groups, clients and blocking; flush the cache.

enum.label: Zone admin
enum.help: Manage zones and their records, transfers and signing.

enum.label: Admin
enum.help: Everything.

fields.label: Name

fields.name: namespace
fields.label: Namespace

items.help: Settings file layered over this file for the cluster-scope keys and watched for changes (hot reload, D25); KUDURRU_SETTINGS_FILE takes precedence. The Helm chart mounts /etc/kudurru/settings/settings.yaml; in Docker PATCH /api/v1/settings persists into it. Empty disables the layer.

enum.label: Kubernetes
enum.help: CRDs through the apiserver.

items.label: Snapshot maximum age

items.label: Kubernetes sync timeout

fields.help: Key name (a domain name) the zones reference in spec.policy.transferTSIGKeyRefs.

fields.name: secretFile

items.label: Bootstrap resolvers

items.label: Conditional forwarding

items.help: Longest IPv4 source prefix sent upstream in ECS (0-32).
items.label: ECS IPv4 prefix length

items.help: Longest IPv6 source prefix sent upstream in ECS (0-128).
items.label: ECS IPv6 prefix length

items.help: EDNS Client Subnet on upstream queries: strip (never send one; privacy default), forward (pass the client's own option), add (forward the client's option, else derive one from a public client address).
items.label: EDNS Client Subnet

enum.label: Strip
enum.help: Never send a client subnet (privacy default).

enum.label: Forward
enum.help: Pass the client's own ECS option, truncated to the prefix limits.

enum.label: Add
enum.help: Forward the client's option, else derive one from a public client address.

items.help: Named upstream groups: servers, strategy (parallel_best, strict, random, rtt_weighted), timeout.
items.label: Upstream groups

fields.name: servers
fields.label: Servers
fields.help: ip[:port], udp://, tcp://, tls://, https://, quic://, h3:// or sdns:// stamps; prefix a display name with name= (cloudflare=tls://1.1.1.1).

fields.name: strategy
fields.label: Strategy
fields.help: Which servers are asked, and in which order.

enum.label: Parallel best
enum.help: Race two healthy servers picked at random and take the first usable answer; if both fail, race the rest.

enum.label: Strict order
enum.help: Ask the servers one after another in the listed order, moving on only on failure.

enum.label: Random
enum.help: Ask one healthy server picked at random; another random one on failure.

enum.label: Fastest (RTT weighted)
enum.help: Pick the first server at random weighted by its inverse round-trip time, then fall back in RTT order.

fields.name: timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Bound of one exchange with one server.
